description: This file contains source code for ASN.1 object representations and management functions related to X.509 extensions and related structures, generated by Cisco's ASN.1 code generator. It includes creation, validation, and helper functions for various ASN.1 types such as Extensions, Extension, AuthorityKeyIdentifier, KeyIdentifier, GeneralNames, GeneralName, ORAddress, EDIPartyName, KeyUsage, ExtKeyUsageSyntax, BasicConstraints, PrivateKeyUsagePeriod, CertificatePolicies, PolicyInformation, and related objects, primarily for certificate handling and parsing.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_EXTENSIONS
classes.description: Represents a sequence of ASN.1 Extension objects, supporting creation and child validation.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_EXTENSION
classes.description: Represents an ASN.1 Extension sequence, with support for extension properties such as extnID, critical, extnValue, and extensionValue.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_AUTHORITYKEYIDENTIFIER
classes.description: Represents the Authority Key Identifier extension, including keyIdentifier, authorityCertIssuer, and serialNumber.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_KEYIDENTIFIER
classes.description: Represents a Key Identifier as an OctetString.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_GENERALNAMES
classes.description: Represents a sequence of GeneralName objects, with methods to add alternative names or Kerberos names.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_GENERALNAME
classes.description: Represents a Choice ASN.1 object for the different types of GeneralName, such as otherName, rfc822Name, dNSName, x400Address, directoryName, ediPartyName, uri, iPAddress, registeredID.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_ORADDRESS
classes.description: Represents an ORAddress as an OctetString.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_EDIPARTYNAME
classes.description: Represents an EDIPartyName sequence with optional nameAssigner and required partyName.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_KEYUSAGE
classes.description: Represents KeyUsage as a BitString.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_EXTKEYUSAGESYNTAX
classes.description: Sequence of OID representing Extended Key Usage Syntax.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_BASICCONSTRAINTS
classes.description: Represents Basic Constraints with optional cA boolean and path length constraint.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_PRIVATEKEYUSAGEPERIOD
classes.description: Sequence with optional notBefore and notAfter GeneralizedTime.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_CERTIFICATEPOLICIES
classes.description: Sequence of PolicyInformation objects representing certificate policies.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_POLICYINFORMATION
classes.description: Sequence with policyIdentifier and policyQualifiers for a certificate policy.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_POLICYINFORMATION
classes.description: Represents the ASN.1 structure PolicyInformation with fields for policy identifier and qualifiers.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_POLICYQUALIFIERS
classes.description: Represents a sequence of PolicyQualifierInfo objects.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_POLICYQUALIFIERINFO
classes.description: Holds a policy qualifier ID and corresponding qualifier object.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_POLICYQUALIFIER
classes.description: Choice object for policy qualifiers, supporting userNotice or cpsuri.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_USERNOTICE
classes.description: Sequence containing noticeRef and explicitText for user notices.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_NOTICEREFERENCE
classes.description: Sequence for organization and notice numbers in notices.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_DISPLAYTEXT
classes.description: Choice structure allowing VisibleString, BMPString, UTF8String, and IA5String types.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_POLICYMAPPINGS
classes.description: Sequence of PolicyMapping objects.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_NAMECONSTRAINTS
classes.description: Sequence with permitted and excluded subtrees for name constraints.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_GENERALSUBTREES
classes.description: Sequence of GeneralSubTree objects.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_GENERALSUBTREE
classes.description: Sequence with base GeneralName and optional minimum and maximum integers.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_POLICYCONSTRAINTS
classes.description: Sequence with requireExplicitPolicy and inhibitPolicyMapping integers.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_SUBJECTDIRECTORYATTRIBUTES
classes.description: Sequence of Attribute objects.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_CRLNUMBER
classes.description: Integer representing a CRL number.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_CRLDISTPOINTSSYNTAX
classes.description: Sequence of DistributionPoint objects.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_DISTRIBUTIONPOINT
classes.description: Sequence with optional distributionPoint, reasons, and cRLIssuer.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_DISTRIBUTIONPOINTNAME
classes.description: Choice of fullName or nameRelativeToCRLIssuer.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_REASONFLAGS
classes.description: BitString for reason flags.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_ISSUINGDISTRIBUTIONPOINT
classes.description: Sequence with optional distributionPoint, onlyConstrainsUserCerts, onlyConstrainsCACerts, onlySomeReasons, and indirectCRL.
